races.paceDynamic: Suspicious Mindz is the only confirmed front runner and should get an uncontested lead with Oust the only other prominent runner likely to track. The majority of the field comprises hold-up horses (Nil Bua Gan Dua, Coasting, Chamonix, Tashakour, Fallacy) who will need the pace to develop. With minimal early pressure, Suspicious Mindz can dictate fractions and kick clear, while the hold-up brigade may find themselves with too much to do if the pace becomes pedestrian. This tactical setup strongly favours the early pace-setters who can avoid traffic and control their own destiny.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Suspicious Mindz Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Suspicious Mindz gets the expected soft lead and Shane Foley can dictate sensible fractions
scenarios.body: The proven front runner can stretch clear in the straight while the hold-up horses struggle for room and pace. His Listed third at Tipperary shows he has the class to exploit this tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong or Suspicious Mindz fails to fire after 196 days off
scenarios.body: The closers get the setup they need with Nil Bua Gan Dua's Group 2 experience and Tashakour's recent heavy ground form coming to the fore. The O'Brien second string could benefit from stronger pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Oust Tracking Success
scenarios.trigger: If Oust can sit just off Suspicious Mindz and Seamie Heffernan times his challenge perfectly
scenarios.body: The prominent runner gets the best of both worlds - avoiding the early speed battle while staying out of trouble that hampers the hold-up horses. His 142-day break becomes less of a concern with tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Suspicious Mindz goes too slow early and gets swamped by multiple challengers in a bunched finish
scenarios.body: A messy finish where positioning becomes crucial and any of the better-rated hold-up horses could prevail in a driving finish. Traffic problems will determine the outcome more than pure ability.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Suspicious Mindz goes too slowly early as this will set up a cavalry charge from the hold-up horses
Monitor Oust's jumping from the gates as prominent position is crucial to avoid being trapped behind the pace
Check if Nil Bua Gan Dua gets early cover as O'Brien's second string could benefit from patient ride
Watch for Tashakour's positioning turning in as recent heavy ground form suggests he needs strong pace
Observe market support for Chamonix as 100,000euro purchase was weak in betting on debut

races.paceDynamic: Dial Me In and Star Strewn are confirmed front-runners who will contest the early lead, with both having shown they need to be handy to be effective. With only two dedicated pace-setters in a nine-runner field, they'll likely settle into a reasonable tempo rather than burn each other up completely. The prominent runners Zia Zabel, Echo Of Faith and Loch Gamhna will track the leaders, while the hold-up horses The Publican's Son, Sursum Corda and Brownstown will have ground to make up in the straight. This moderate pace scenario clearly favours prominent runners and those with tactical speed over pure hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Dial Me In and Star Strewn settle into a reasonable tempo without going too hard early
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get the perfect trip tracking the leaders before pouncing, while the hold-up horses find themselves with too much to do. Echo Of Faith and Zia Zabel benefit most from this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front-Runners Survive
scenarios.trigger: If the two pace-setters go fast enough to deter challengers but maintain stamina reserves
scenarios.body: One of the leaders kicks clear in the final furlong as the closers leave their runs too late. Dial Me In's proven track form and Star Strewn's recent Dundalk win suggest they can handle the tempo they set.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Late Charge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely moderate and the field compresses turning in
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kicks in a bunched finish. The Publican's Son's Group 3 second and Brownstown's class edge become decisive factors in a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Newcomer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Why Wyoming shows the ability that breeding and connections suggest she possesses
scenarios.body: The Intello filly benefits from race fitness concerns among rivals and Kevin Coleman's 0/6 record creates a false sense of security in the market. Her half-siblings' winning record suggests she has the class to exploit any tactical gaps.

races.paceDynamic: Magna Gee Gee and He's Holding Court will contest the early pace, with both confirmed front runners likely to set a reasonable gallop over this 1m trip. In a large field of 21 runners, most are hold-up horses who will need the pace to develop, creating a bunching effect entering the straight. The presence of two natural leaders should establish enough pace to set up the race for closers. This pace dynamic strongly favours hold-up horses and prominent racers who can position themselves for a late challenge, rather than those committed to leading or tracking the pace early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Magna Gee Gee and He's Holding Court engage in early battle creating solid tempo.
scenarios.body: The strong gallop stretches the field and sets up perfect conditions for hold-up horses to finish strongly. Late-running types with proven stamina at the trip will have ideal conditions to mount winning challenges.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Pace Benefits Prominent
scenarios.trigger: If one leader gets easy time up front with the other settling or fading early.
scenarios.body: The race becomes more tactical with moderate pace, suiting horses that can track the leader and quicken when asked. Those with tactical speed who can position prominently will have the edge over pure hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Magna Gee Gee gets uncontested lead and maintains strong gallop throughout.
scenarios.body: The leader establishes commanding position and sustains the effort, making it difficult for closers to peg back the advantage. Front runners and prominent racers who can stay in touch benefit most.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Slow Pace Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders settle too readily creating pedestrian early fractions.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a cavalry charge with most of the field in contention entering the final furlong. Horses with proven finishing kicks and those drawn well benefit from the tactical affair.

watchPoints.text: Magna Gee Gee and He's Holding Court both confirmed pace-setters could set unsustainable fractions if engaging early

races.paceDynamic: Big Dispute will take the field along from the front as the only confirmed pace-setter, likely joined by prominent runners Cut The Rope, Enceladus, Theorist and The Rock Factor in the early stages. With 16 runners but limited early pace, Big Dispute can dictate terms and set a manageable gallop over this stamina-testing trip on yielding ground. The large field of hold-up horses including Trojan Fighter, Eternal Echo, Reynir and the three newcomers will create congestion in behind, making smooth passages crucial. This race shape clearly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can secure good positions early and avoid traffic problems.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Big Dispute Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Big Dispute gets an uncontested lead and manages fractions effectively
scenarios.body: The experienced hurdler can kick clear in the straight as hold-up horses struggle to navigate traffic in the large field. Front-runners and prominent racers benefit from the tactical advantage and clear runs.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Cooker
scenarios.trigger: If Cut The Rope, Enceladus and Theorist press Big Dispute from the start
scenarios.body: The increased early pace will suit horses with finishing kicks positioned in midfield with clear runs. Quality newcomers and proven stayers can pick up the pieces as the leaders tire.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Backfires
scenarios.trigger: If the large field bunches up and multiple hold-up horses get blocked
scenarios.body: Early leaders maintain their advantage as the field struggles to mount challenges from behind on the testing ground. Horses that secure good early positions prove unassailable.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If one of the three debutants Almazann, Confused or Strike De Vega shows unexpectedly high ability
scenarios.body: Superior class tells despite tactical disadvantages, with the newcomer's fresh legs and potential quality overcoming positional deficits. Other hold-up horses with proven form can also capitalize.

watchPoints.text: Big Dispute's market price will reveal stable confidence in his Flat debut switching from hurdles
Traffic problems inevitable with 16 runners and many hold-up horses on a turning track
Almazann and Confused represent top-class connections making debuts and could show unexpected ability
Cut The Rope returning from 173-day break may need the run despite solid historical Flat form
Reynir's gate behaviour after missing break badly on debut will determine his chances

races.paceDynamic: Limestone will lead uncontested from the start, with only four runners and no other natural front-runners in this small field. Mr Vettori may try to sit prominent but won't pressure the leader, while Port Ferdinand and Summer Is Tomorrow will settle further back. With Limestone able to dictate fractions without pressure, the pace will be steady rather than searching, allowing the leader to kick clear turning for home. This tactical setup strongly favours the front-runner and any horse that can travel prominently, as hold-up horses will face a difficult task closing ground against an uncontested leader.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Limestone Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Limestone jumps cleanly and establishes an uncontested lead
scenarios.body: The Joseph O'Brien-trained gelding can dictate ideal fractions and kick clear turning for home, with his proven stamina over this trip proving decisive. His September Listowel success making all the running provides the exact template for victory here.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Port Ferdinand Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the O'Brien colt settles better than on his juvenile debut and travels strongly
scenarios.body: His class advantage from Ballydoyle could tell late in the race, especially if Limestone's long absence tells in the closing stages. The step up in trip should suit this Camelot colt who was doing his best work late when winning as a two-year-old.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mr Vettori Prominent Challenge
scenarios.trigger: If the Harrington runner can sit close enough to Limestone without using too much energy
scenarios.body: His consistent juvenile form suggests he can sit handy and mount a challenge, particularly if the pace becomes too steady for the hold-up horses. Shane Foley's experience could prove crucial in timing a move from a prominent position.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Summer Is Tomorrow Rallies
scenarios.trigger: If the race develops into a true staying test with a strong gallop throughout
scenarios.body: His proven stamina at this trip and beyond could see him finish strongest of all, but he faces a major tactical disadvantage giving the leaders too much rope. Julian Pietropaolo's 7lb claim won't compensate for the poor draw of racing tactics.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Limestone gets into an early pace battle with Mr Vettori as this could set up the race for the closers.
Monitor Port Ferdinand's jumping on seasonal debut as any early mistakes could compromise his finishing kick.
Check if Summer Is Tomorrow can get closer to the pace than usual given the small field and tactical disadvantage.
Observe the going changes throughout the card as conditions may ease further, potentially favouring the stamina horses.
Watch for any market moves on Port Ferdinand given the Ballydoyle stable's excellent record with returning horses.

races.paceDynamic: Apercu is the sole confirmed front-runner and will get an uncontested lead from the flag, setting a sustainable gallop that won't come under serious pressure until the home turn. Iron Fist, Genealogy, and Calm The Jets will sit in the prominent positions but lack the natural speed to press early. The large field of hold-up horses including Dar Toungi, Defiantly, and Westminster Moon will be relying on the pace to collapse in the final two furlongs. This tactical setup strongly favours prominent runners who can track the lone leader without getting involved in any mid-race scrambling.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Apercu Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Apercu gets his preferred sustainable tempo and is allowed to dictate from the front without pressure
scenarios.body: The defending course winner will have every chance to repeat his 2024 success as he gets the exact race conditions that suit him best. Prominent trackers like Iron Fist and Genealogy will be perfectly positioned to challenge but may struggle to reel in a horse who knows this track intimately.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Swarm Late
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely steady and the large contingent of closers gets the strong gallop they need in the final three furlongs
scenarios.body: Dar Toungi and Defiantly have the class to exploit a truly-run race, with Westminster Moon's proven stamina coming into play. The European form of Dar Toungi could prove superior if he gets the right setup after his disappointing Irish debut.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Pressure Changes Dynamic
scenarios.trigger: If Iron Fist or Genealogy decide to press Apercu earlier than expected in the back straight
scenarios.body: Any sustained pressure on the leader will set up a different tactical battle where horses with tactical speed like Final Voyage and Ben Lawers can benefit. Calm The Jets could also profit from a more genuine pace if his Dundalk form translates to turf.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Apercu goes too slow early and the race becomes a sprint finish from the two-furlong pole
scenarios.body: Bay Colony and Quatre Bras have shown recent promise and could exploit a messy finish where class matters less than position and luck in running. Amplitude's heavy ground form gives him an outside chance if the race falls apart.

watchPoints.text: Apercu could get a completely uncontested lead with no other natural pace angles in this large field
Iron Fist sits perfectly behind Apercu but must prove his soft ground form translates to yielding conditions
Dar Toungi's European class could be underestimated by market after his poor Irish debut over inadequate trip
The inside draw positions could be crucial with 17 runners on Cork's turning track configuration
Ben Lawers and Calm The Jets are both stepping up significantly in distance and may not stay the extended trip

races.paceDynamic: Honouramongthieves will take these along from the front with minimal early pressure, as most of this field prefers to settle. Delusional may track in second but the majority - including Servare, Yousaynothingatall, Nod Of Approval, Sea Of Dubka, Pliny and Darius Dark - will settle towards the rear in typical hold-up fashion. This creates a straightforward pace scenario where Honouramongthieves sets sustainable fractions without being harassed early. The race will develop into a staying test from the turn, suiting horses with tactical speed who can quicken off the steady pace rather than pure front-runners.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Honouramongthieves maintains an even gallop without folding
scenarios.body: The steady tempo allows closers with finishing kicks to organize their challenge, while the leader's stamina reserves get tested over the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Honouramongthieves gets soft fractions and stays strong
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure means the leader saves energy for a sustained finish, while hold-up horses struggle to make up ground on the good-to-soft surface.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the steady early gallop becomes a crawl turning in
scenarios.body: Multiple hold-up horses converge simultaneously in a bunch finish, creating traffic problems and favoring those with room to maneuver.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Backfire
scenarios.trigger: If hold-up horses wait too long behind the slow pace
scenarios.body: The patient tactics backfire as Honouramongthieves and Delusional have built an unassailable lead entering the straight.

Honouramongthieves tends to race too keenly which could undermine his front-running tactics over this stamina-testing trip
Multiple hold-up horses including Nod Of Approval, Sea Of Dubka and Darius Dark all show patterns of weakening late in their races
Yousaynothingatall represents the in-form Joseph O'Brien stable with Declan McDonogh taking the ride, suggesting confidence in improvement
The yielding ground conditions favor horses with proven form on soft surfaces, giving an edge to Honouramongthieves and Servare
